_comment: Maps the `relation` value in relation_results_ngaben.json to a canonical predicate. As of the 2026 predicate-cascade rewrite the notebook emits FINAL natural predicates directly (ADALAH, BAGIAN_DARI, DIBUNGKUS_DENGAN, MENGGUNAKAN, ...), so this file is now just: (a) the OLD 12 bucket names, kept so a stale relation JSON still normalises; (b) a few near-synonym merges; (c) DIKENAI -> LAINNYA (the catch-all was retired). Everything else -- including the open tail of voiced-verb predicates -- passes through unchanged (normalize.py's VOICED_PREDICATE regex accepts it). If you add a merge here, keep CANONICAL_RELATIONS in normalize.py in sync and re-run normalize.py.
_comment_2026_09_07: Predicate-sync pass: the notebook cascade's open tail had grown to 264 distinct predicates; these fold true synonyms/variants into the canonical set. Everything not listed still passes through unchanged via normalize.py's VOICED_PREDICATE regex. Keep CANONICAL_RELATIONS in normalize.py in sync.
